note: Flux-Cored capacity 0.030/0.035/0.045 in; largest is 0.045 (p.7).

q: What's the biggest wire spool this machine will take?
note: Wire Spool Capacity: up to 12 lb spool (p.7).

q: How far should the contact tip be from the workpiece when MIG welding?
note: CTWD up to 1/2 inch (p.31).

q: Which way do I tilt the gun for solid MIG wire versus flux-cored wire?
note: Solid+gas = push angle; flux-cored = drag angle; 0-15 degrees (p.31).

q: I'm getting big grainy spatter everywhere. What's causing it and how do I fix it?
note: Fine spatter normal; grainy/large is a problem -> voltage/WFS/CTWD/polarity checklist (p.38).

q: I keep blowing holes through thin sheet metal. How do I stop burning through?
note: Burn-through = too much heat: reduce voltage/WFS, faster travel, shorter CTWD (p.35/p.39).

q: How should I grind the tungsten electrode for TIG?
note: Grind lengthwise; conical tip 2-1/2x the electrode diameter (p.26).

q: Which drive roller groove do I use for solid MIG wire versus flux-cored wire?
note: Solid = smooth V-groove; flux-cored = knurled groove (p.12).

note: In scope: aluminum weldable with the OPTIONAL Spool Gun (p.7) -> must state the accessory, not refuse outright.

note: Maximum OCV 86VDC on both inputs (p.7).
